items.title: trampolines: Don't set PYTHONHOME, set __PYVENV_LAUNCHER__ only in venvs
items.reason: Closest historical fix: documents startup failures on Python 3.10 and older when __PYVENV_LAUNCHER__ points to a standalone Windows launcher without an effective PYTHONHOME. Released in uv 0.11.9. The reported Python 3.8 shim predates this fix, making an unchanged older launcher plausible but unconfirmed.

items.title: uv 0.11.7 with 3.13 interpreter on windows fails to build python wheel for cp311/cp312 using cibuildwheel
items.reason: Fixed by astral-sh/uv#19199, establishing the Windows launcher's PYTHONHOME handling and fix history. Its confirmed symptom was a child Python loading another version's standard library; this report concerns Python 3.8 failing to find encodings during an isolated query, so it is not an established duplicate.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues for the exact query failure, python3.8.exe, init_fs_encoding, missing encodings, and the listing warning. Broadened to broken discovery, shims, launchers, trampolines, PYTHONHOME and __PYVENV_LAUNCHER__, including searches without version/platform restrictions. Open, closed and merged PR searches returned no entries even for known matches; supplemented with the complete open-PR listing, direct PR/comment/review reads, trampoline commit history and release notes. Followed astral-sh/uv#19199 to astral-sh/uv#19080 and astral-sh/uv#13531. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#12617 (slow queries), astral-sh/uv#12173 and astral-sh/uv#8821 (Unix venv/symlink home resolution), astral-sh/uv#19374 and astral-sh/uv#20853 (console scripts escaping symlinked venvs), astral-sh/uv#8649 (Python 3.7 ZIP compatibility), and astral-sh/uv#21047 (alleged discovery abort; this listing continues). Closed/merged PR coverage was limited by the search results.

type_reason: The reported Python 3.8 launcher cannot initialize its standard library, which is incorrect behavior; python list reports the failed query and continues. A related fix shipped before the reported uv version, but the failing shim predates that fix. Neither a stale launcher nor a regression with a freshly generated launcher is confirmed, so classifying this as a duplicate would be premature.
summary: The closest match is astral-sh/uv#19199 and its associated issue astral-sh/uv#19080. An older retained shim is plausible; no confirmed duplicate or regression was established. The required README could not be updated because the filesystem is read-only; a fallback write to /tmp was also blocked.
draft_response:
The warning comes from the Python 3.8 launcher failing to start; `uv python list` continues listing the other interpreters. astral-sh/uv#19199 fixed a Windows launcher startup problem affecting Python 3.10 and older, released in uv 0.11.9. Your `python3.8.exe` is dated January 15, before that fix, so it may still contain the older launcher.

Please try `uv python install 3.8 --reinstall` with the same custom Python installation and executable-directory settings, then retry `uv python list --only-installed`. If the warning remains, please share `uv python list --only-installed -vv` output and the results of running both the shim and its managed `python.exe` directly with `-I -c "import encodings; print(encodings.__file__)"`. That will help determine whether the failure is specific to the launcher.
